app.name: Phishing URL Detector
app.tagline: Check any link before you click it

scan.title: Is this link safe?
scan.subtitle: Paste the suspicious link you received by SMS or e-mail. We'll analyze it instantly and explain how risky it is and why.
scan.error: Couldn't reach the server. Make sure the backend is running.

result.noReasons: No warning signs were found in this link.

batch.title: Scan many links at once
batch.subtitle: Paste a full SMS or e-mail. We'll extract every link and scan them all. Defanged links like hxxp and [.] are supported.
batch.placeholder: Dear customer, your account has been suspended. Please update here: https://…
batch.max: Up to 50 links at a time.

history.title: Scan history
history.subtitle: Every link you've checked, with quick statistics.
history.confirmClear: Delete the whole history? This can't be undone.
history.empty: No scans yet. Start by checking a link!

footer.disclaimer: Results are estimates based on local heuristic rules and can't guarantee 100% safety. When in doubt, don't enter your details.
footer.privacy: Analysis runs entirely on your own server; links are never sent to third parties.
